exact_scopes.source_fact: Feltoe1896 printed42 physical66 corrected by same-edition erratum physical24; this is a critical printed witness, not an exact manuscript reproduction. AAS1942 and1962 supply exact later target attestation and are separately disclosed.
exact_scopes.whole_arrangement_assessment: The old single prayer supplies the continuous governing sequence: look upon the flock and keep it under perpetual protection through the appointed shepherds. The exact later edit retains that sequence. The change in addressee epithet, singular name/office/martyr slot, necessary relative and predicate agreement, removal of Filii tui vicarios, and conventional conclusion completion form a limited adaptation of that one template. Taken together, these do not add a new narrative, juxtaposition of separate source prayers, or independently developed petition. This supports the qualified view that the new contribution remains routine and below sufficient original authorship.
exact_scopes.strongest_contrary_argument: Replacing apostles/vicars of the Son with a SupremePontiff and omitting the vicar clause is a theological redaction, not wholly mechanical grammar. The aggregate could be treated as minimally creative expressive adaptation. The cited authorities do not decide this prayer, so publication is proposed under policy priority6 rather than asserted as an unqualified historical whole-prayer public-domain identity.

root_decision: Adopt the qualified per-text assessment for these two exact forms. The continuous older whole petition supplies the arrangement; the bounded rank/name/agreement and conventional conclusion redaction is assessed together as routine rather than a new developed petition. The theological-redaction originality objection remains disclosed and limits confidence. This is not literal whole-prayer identity or an unqualified public-domain claim. Damasus is assessed independently under the same rationale, never used as authority for Common.

official_legal_sources.rule: Original authorship and any new derivative contribution must be distinguished from preexisting material. Foreign-work restoration cannot be dismissed merely for missing US formalities.
The 95-year published-work term, where applicable, runs through the calendar-year end;1932/1942 publication alone establishes no expired US term in2026.
Routine grammatical edits, names and short phrases can lack authorship; protected selection or adaptation remains possible. Consider the actual whole, not a count of isolated words.
A derivative can use one or more older works; new copyright would cover only sufficient new authorship.
Originality has a low creativity threshold; effort alone does not suffice, and original selection/arrangement can matter.
